title: 8C Spend or Save? — Идиомы: деньги и траты

items.example: Put a little aside and save for a rainy day.
You look worried — a penny for your thoughts?
He works hard for every penny he earns.
We had to tighten our belts after the move.

items.idiom: money burns a hole in one's pocket
items.example: Payday came and the money burned a hole in his pocket.
Turn off the lights — money doesn't grow on trees!

items.idiom: cost an arm and a leg
items.example: The new phone costs an arm and a leg.
Tourists pay through the nose for souvenirs.
It's hard to make ends meet on one salary.
Credit cards make it easy to live beyond your means.

items.idiom: keep the wolf from the door
items.example: A steady job keeps the wolf from the door.
They built a small nest egg for retirement.
Both parents bring home the bacon in our family.
After the holiday I was flat broke.
Just my two cents, but saving young makes sense.
